description: Paste any suspicious text — a message, email, marketplace listing, job offer, investment pitch or link — and get a plain verdict (REAL / SUSPICIOUS / LIKELY SCAM) with every check shown, a warning score, what to do next, a signed verdict certificate, and a shareable verdict link. Content is processed, not stored.

subscriptionCode.description: Optional subscription code (Personal Pro / Team). The check draws on the plan’s monthly credit allowance instead of the free daily credits.

text.description: The full suspicious message or text to check (10–8000 characters).

name: check_message
title: Check a suspicious message
